# Flow 89.2: Sample Query and Reporting

## Purpose
Second conversational flow inside sample-domain proving reading data created by Flow 89.1 with zero modifications to Flow 89.1 or core files.

## Roles
- `SUPER_ADMIN`
- `ADMIN`

## Telegram Ergonomics
- Callback: `action:sample:refresh` (21 bytes <= 36 bytes limit)
- Keyboard: 1 row, 2 buttons.
